title: GET DCOUNTER with INCREMENT, GET with WRAP at the counter's default maximum (rewinds to the minimum), and a GET without WRAP at the limit (SUPPRESSED RESP2 101, counter unchanged)

scenarios.summary: DEFINE VALUE(10), GET INCREMENT(5) twice, QUERY, a GET with the default increment, QUERY
DEFINE at max-2, GETs up to the default maximum, GET WRAP rewinds to the minimum, QUERY, GET
DEFINE at max-1, GETs up to the maximum, then GET (with and without INCREMENT) without WRAP at the limit: SUPPRESSED RESP2 101, then GET WRAP and GET
